scenes.say: 本周改带水杯，只用八只。纸杯可以数，用 fewer 比较两个数量。 We used fewer paper cups this week.
items: We used twenty paper cups last week.
We used fewer paper cups this week.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 告诉读者具体少了多少。二十减八等于十二，比较结果要带单位。 We used twelve fewer cups.
items: We used fewer paper cups this week.

question: 从二十只减到八只，应该如何汇报？
explanation: 20 减 8 等于 12，数量下降要说 fewer。

title: 用年代和地点写人物小传

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 写历史人物时先锁定时代，再说贡献。例如东汉时期蔡伦改进了造纸工艺。 Cai Lun improved papermaking in ancient China.
items: Cai Lun improved papermaking in ancient China.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 描述过去存在的事物要用 there was 或 there were。复数技术办法用 were。 There were earlier ways to make paper.
items: Cai Lun improved papermaking in ancient China.
There were earlier ways to make paper.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 最后区分发明与改进。已有工艺得到改进，用 improved 比 created the first 更准确。 He improved a method that already existed.
items: There were earlier ways to make paper.
He improved a method that already existed.

question: 要表达在他之前已有别的造纸办法，应选哪句？
explanation: earlier 指更早，were 与复数 methods 搭配。

title: 把人物贡献写成有证据的句子

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 写学校人物展板，只写“他很伟大”还不够。先说这位人物做了什么。 Louis Braille developed a reading system based on raised dots.
items: Louis Braille developed a reading system based on raised dots.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 接下来解释它怎样发挥作用。raised dots 是凸起的点，人们用指尖感知排列。 Readers feel the dots with their fingertips.
items: Louis Braille developed a reading system based on raised dots.
Readers feel the dots with their fingertips.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 结尾说明影响时，选 can 表示这种方法带来的可能。 People can read by touch using this system.
items: Readers feel the dots with their fingertips.
People can read by touch using this system.

question: 哪句话最具体地解释了这种系统怎样工作？
choices: Readers feel patterns of raised dots.
explanation: 凸点的组合和触摸动作解释了它的工作方式。

title: 给一天做三格行程卡

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 把纸分成三格。第一格画早晨起床，配上动作，再加上时间。 I get up at seven.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 第二格写怎样去上学。by bus 说明出行方式。 I go to school by bus.
items: I go to school by bus.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 第三格画下午踢球。边指三幅画边按时间顺序说给家人听。 I play football after school.
items: I go to school by bus.

question: 如果第二格要说明怎样上学，应该写什么？
explanation: by bus 给出了交通方式。

title: 给小鱼做季节转盘

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 想象你是故事里的小鱼。第一格画春天，配上能看到的一样东西。 In spring, I see flowers.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 夏天池塘里很暖和，告诉伙伴你的感受。warm 是暖和。 In summer, the water is warm.
items: In summer, the water is warm.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 冬天再转一格。先报季节，再说你的水下世界变成什么样。 In winter, the water is cold.
items: In summer, the water is warm.
In winter, the water is cold.

question: 冬天这格用哪个开头？
explanation: winter 是冬天。

title: 我的成长名片

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 做一张自己的小名片，先选你最喜欢的一种水果。 I like pears.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 第二行写一种你会做的运动，can 后面用动作。 I can swim.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 第三行介绍一个感官发现，比如早上听到小鸟。读给同伴，互相猜猜卡片属于谁。 I can hear birds in the morning.
items: I can hear birds in the morning.

question: 哪句适合写在“我会做什么”的一栏？
explanation: can run 表示会跑。

title: 五感小展板

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 展板的一侧写身体部位，另一侧写它带来的发现。眼睛这栏先写看到的东西。 I see a red bag with my eyes.
items: I see a red bag with my eyes.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 耳朵能帮我们听声。用 with my ears 说用什么听。 I hear music with my ears.
items: I see a red bag with my eyes.
I hear music with my ears.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 现在补上鼻子，举一个闻得到的例子。 I smell a flower with my nose.
items: I hear music with my ears.
I smell a flower with my nose.

question: 哪一项可以放进耳朵栏？
explanation: hear 对应听觉。

title: 让别人听懂我的收藏

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 带一件喜欢的玩具，先用 favourite 说明它在你心里的位置。 My favourite toy is a boat.
items: My favourite toy is a boat.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 接着描述它。说出颜色和特征，朋友能在一堆玩具中认出它。 It is blue and it has a white sail.
items: My favourite toy is a boat.
It is blue and it has a white sail.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 最后加一句理由，用 because 接上会动的特点。 I like it because it can float.
items: It is blue and it has a white sail.
I like it because it can float.

question: 哪项信息解释了喜欢的原因？
choices: It can float, and I enjoy watching it.
explanation: 提到喜欢观看漂浮的船，说明了喜好和特点的关系。

title: 用四格海报讲四季

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 在四格海报上写四个季节。第一格用 spring，配春天的花。 In spring, flowers open.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 第三格用 autumn，把落下的叶子画进来。 In autumn, leaves fall.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 把空着的夏、冬两格补上活动，再动手检查四个季节是否齐了。 I swim in summer and skate in winter.
items: I swim in summer and skate in winter.

question: autumn 这一格应该放在哪两个季节之间？
explanation: 四季顺序是 spring、summer、autumn、winter。

title: 给儿童节小报道录音

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 先交代今天是什么日子，听众才知道活动的由来。 Today is Children's Day.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 给表演标出地点。on the stage 指在舞台上。 We dance on the stage.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 再访问一位观众的感受，听完可以替换 happy 为他的实际回答。 My friend feels happy.

question: 哪句话说明表演的地点？
explanation: on the stage 提供地点。

title: 做能用的郊游物品单

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 计划班级郊游，先说目的地，再决定应该带什么。 We are going to the park.
items: We are going to the park.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 给同行者的清单最好写清数量。water 通常按瓶数。 Pack two bottles of water.
items: We are going to the park.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 加上一个天气条件，让同伴能按情况准备。 Take a hat if it is sunny.
items: Take a hat if it is sunny.

question: 为什么写 two bottles of water 比 water 更具体？
choices: 说明了水的数量和单位
explanation: two 是数量，bottles 是计数单位。

title: 比较两个运动社团

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 选择社团前先填一张三栏卡，记录星期、地点和活动。 Basketball club meets on Monday.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 把同一项信息并排比较。另一个社团时间不同，用 but 连接。 Swimming club meets on Friday, but basketball club meets on Monday.
items: Swimming club meets on Friday, but basketball club meets on Monday.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 现在说明你的选择和理由。若周五有空，可这样说。 I choose swimming because I am free on Friday.
items: Swimming club meets on Friday, but basketball club meets on Monday.
I choose swimming because I am free on Friday.

question: 要确定两个社团是否时间冲突，应先比较哪一栏？
explanation: 是否冲突取决于活动时间。

title: 采访家人的周末

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 采访家人分两个问题。usually 问通常怎样过周末。 What do you usually do at weekends?
items: What do you usually do at weekends?

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 现在把镜头对准这一刻，用现在进行时问此刻在做什么。 What are you doing now?
items: What do you usually do at weekends?

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 整理答复时给两种时间各保留一句，读者才能分清习惯和现状。 I usually read, but now I am cooking.
items: I usually read, but now I am cooking.

question: 想问家人此刻做什么，选哪句？
choices: What do you do every Sunday?
What did you do last week?
explanation: now 加进行时指此刻。

title: 给春节活动做小海报

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 海报标题告诉读者是什么节日。先写春节的英文名称。 The Spring Festival is a special time for my family.
items: The Spring Festival is a special time for my family.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 正文选一件你家确实会做的事。注意 lots of families 和 my family 范围不同。 In my family, we make dumplings together.
items: The Spring Festival is a special time for my family.
In my family, we make dumplings together.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 再写一句祝福作为结尾。先给家人的祝福，也试着改写给朋友。 I wish my family a happy new year.
items: In my family, we make dumplings together.
I wish my family a happy new year.

question: 哪句话明确说的是自己家的做法？
choices: In my family, we cook together.
It is always the same everywhere.
explanation: in my family 限定了介绍的对象。

title: 让小实验的记录可以比较

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 做豆苗观察实验，给同一株植物定好测量时刻。measure 表示测量。 Measure the plant at nine each morning.
items: Measure the plant at nine each morning.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 把数字和单位一起写。只写 eight，别人不知道你量的是厘米还是天数。 It is eight centimetres tall today.
items: Measure the plant at nine each morning.
It is eight centimetres tall today.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 一周结束时，把第一次和最后一次的高度放在同一句。 It grew from five to eight centimetres.
items: It is eight centimetres tall today.
It grew from five to eight centimetres.

question: 哪种记录最利于比较长高多少？
explanation: 两次高度都有相同单位，可以作比较。

title: 排一张才艺节目单

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 节目单先写第一个节目和表演者，名字放在动作前。 First, Lin plays the violin.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 下一项邀请三人合唱。三人作主语时 sing 用原形。 Next, three friends sing a song.
items: Next, three friends sing a song.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 最后安排全组谢幕。检查 first、next、last 对应的顺序。 Last, we all take a bow.
items: Next, three friends sing a song.
Last, we all take a bow.

question: 哪句说明表演者是三个人？
explanation: three friends 是复数主语。

title: 给学校的变化配图说

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 比较新旧两张照片。先说以前校园里有什么，一个场地用 there was。 There was a small playground.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 说现在新增的地方，按实际数量选择 there is 或 there are。 There are two new gardens now.
items: There are two new gardens now.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 再写这些变化怎样影响同学，例如新图书馆让更多人可以一起看书。 We can read together in the new library.
items: There are two new gardens now.
We can read together in the new library.

question: 哪两项最适合作为“学校的变化”的证据？
choices: 同一地点不同时期的照片
explanation: 同一地点前后对照，更能说明变化。

title: 把参观问题变成说明牌

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 参观前写一个可调查的问题。比如想知道小桥模型使用什么材料。 What is this model bridge made of?
items: What is this model bridge made of?

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 看清说明牌后再写答案。made of 后面说仍可辨认的材料。 It is made of wood.
items: What is this model bridge made of?

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 最后用一句话说明哪里最有意思。指出模型的细节，好让下一位观众找得到。 Look at the tiny steps beside the bridge.
items: Look at the tiny steps beside the bridge.

question: Which material is named in It is made of wood?
explanation: made of 后面是材料名称，wood 是木材。

unit: Unit 1 · Is it fun at school?
title: 学校里最好玩的活动

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 有人问在学校有趣吗？听一般疑问句，先回答 yes 或 no。 Is it fun at school?

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 回答后举个具体的活动。at break 表示在课间。 Yes, it is. We play games at break.
items: Yes, it is. We play games at break.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 把 games 换成自己喜欢的学校活动。试说和朋友唱歌。 We sing with friends at school.
items: Yes, it is. We play games at break.
We sing with friends at school.

question: 听到 Is it fun at school? 哪个回答最合适？
explanation: 用 is 提问，先用 Yes, it is 回答。

unit: Unit 2 · Let's go out and play
title: 发邀请也会回应

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 课间朋友坐在教室里，想邀请他一起去外面玩。let's 就是让我们一起。 Let's play outside.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 如果想让伙伴具体知道玩什么，改成一种游戏。 Let's play catch.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 你愿意去时可以肯定答复；如果没空，也可以礼貌说明。 Sorry, I can't play now.

question: 哪句礼貌地表示现在不能参加？
explanation: can't play now 表示此刻不能玩。

title: 小宠物闯了什么祸

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 看一只小狗叼走拖鞋。naughty 描述淘气的样子。先介绍谁在那儿。 This is my puppy.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 说它此刻正做什么，用 is 加动作的 ing 形式。 It is playing with my shoe.
items: It is playing with my shoe.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 要请它放下，直接用动词开头。it 在这里指拖鞋。 Put it down, please.
items: It is playing with my shoe.

question: It is playing with my shoe 讲的是哪种情况？
explanation: is playing 表示正在做的动作。

title: 字母换位意思全变

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 拿出字母卡 o 和 n。把 o 放前面得到 on，表示在上面。 The cup is on the table.
items: The cup is on the table.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 把 n 移到前面，两个相同的字母变成 no，表示否定。读英语要看字母顺序。 No, it isn't my cup.
items: The cup is on the table.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 再看 in 和 on，注意开头的字母。杯子在盒子里面，应该怎样说？ The cup is in the box.
items: The cup is in the box.

question: 哪一个词是把 n 放在 o 的前面？
explanation: n 在前、o 在后拼成 no。

unit: Unit 5 · She's got everything beautiful for us
title: 说明谁带来了什么

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 班级美化角需要材料，小宁带来了几朵花。说某一位同学有东西，用 has got。 She has got some flowers.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 换成自己拥有，has 变成 have。have got 的意思是有。 I have got some paper.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 如果是两个人一起带来了画笔，用 they 作主语，让 have 保持原形。 They have got two brushes.

question: She ___ got a picture. 应选哪个词？
explanation: 第三人称单数 she 搭配 has got。

unit: Unit 6 · We've got a lot of fun in the playroom
title: 游戏室里玩得开心

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 游戏室有拼图和积木。说玩得开心，用 have fun。 We have fun in the playroom.
items: We have fun in the playroom.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 说拥有某件东西时，用 have got，后面放物品。留意 have fun 和 have got 的意思。 We have got a big puzzle.
items: We have fun in the playroom.
We have got a big puzzle.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 请新来的朋友加入，把疑问句 Can you 和动作 help 连起来。 Can you help us with the puzzle?
items: We have got a big puzzle.
Can you help us with the puzzle?

question: We have fun in the playroom 表示什么？
choices: 我们在游戏室玩得开心
explanation: have fun 表示玩得愉快。

title: 为家人写送花小卡

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 一朵康乃馨叫 a carnation。for 加人表示礼物送给谁。 This carnation is for my mother.
items: This carnation is for my mother.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 把礼物递给妈妈，可以把 my mother 换成 you，因为她就在眼前。 This flower is for you.
items: This carnation is for my mother.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 试着写一行感谢的话，for 后也能接一件值得感谢的事情。 Thank you for your help.

question: 卡片上 For Mum 的意思是什么？
explanation: for 标出礼物的接受者。

title: 在书架旁交换喜好

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 书架旁摆着几本绘本。说喜欢这一类书用复数 picture books。 I like picture books.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 问同桌的喜好时，可用 What books do you like? 保留 books 的复数。 What books do you like?

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 介绍一本推荐的书，用 and 把两个特点连起来。 It has a funny story and bright pictures.
items: It has a funny story and bright pictures.

question: 想问朋友喜欢哪类书，应该说什么？
explanation: what books 是问书的类别。

title: 给水果沙拉写配料单

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 准备水果沙拉，先列配料。one 后面用单数 banana。 We need one banana.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 还需要几颗葡萄。some 后面用 grapes 的复数。 We need some grapes too.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 写最后一个制作步骤，用 mix 开头，them 代表刚才的水果。 Mix them in a bowl.

question: 补完整。We need some ___.
explanation: 葡萄可数，some 可接复数 grapes。

title: 用口令玩抢椅子

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 演示游戏规则时先说要做的动作。围着椅子走，around 表示围着。 Walk around the chairs.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 接下来告诉大家何时坐下。when 用来说明动作发生的时机。 Sit down when the music stops.
items: Sit down when the music stops.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 如果伙伴没听清，放慢说出两个关键动作，大家先走再坐。 Walk first. Then sit down.
items: Sit down when the music stops.

question: 什么时候坐下？
explanation: when 后面给出的条件是音乐停止。

title: 当一分钟新闻播报员

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 校园新闻先告诉观众发生了什么。news 作不可数名词，常和 is 搭配。 Here is the school news.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 接着给地点，让听众可以核对信息。 There is a book fair in the hall.
items: There is a book fair in the hall.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 最后再补时间。如果活动是今天下午两点，把 at two 放进句中。 It starts at two this afternoon.
items: There is a book fair in the hall.
It starts at two this afternoon.

question: 哪条信息说明新闻事件发生的地点？
explanation: hall 是礼堂，in the hall 指在礼堂里。

title: 从鸟的外形推断本领

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 在观察卡上画一只鸟，标出两只翅膀。wing 加 s 表示一对中的两只。 The bird has two wings.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 长在嘴部的喙叫 beak，说一个用 a。可以用它啄食种子。 It picks up seeds with its beak.
items: It picks up seeds with its beak.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 轮到你把外形和动作连成一句。试说这只小鸟张开了翅膀。 It opens its wings.
items: It picks up seeds with its beak.

question: 鸟用什么部位啄起种子？
explanation: beak 是喙。

title: 让转学生加入对话

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 欢迎转学来的同学，可以先问对方喜欢怎样被称呼。 What is your name?

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 介绍自己的学校或班级时用 welcome to，to 后面加地点或集体。 Welcome to our class.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 给对方一个实际邀请。next to me 表示在我旁边。 Would you like to sit next to me?
items: Would you like to sit next to me?

question: 哪句邀请新同学在你旁边就座？
choices: Would you like to sit next to me?
explanation: would you like to 提出邀请，next to me 说明位置。

title: 看日历找日期

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 翻开日历，询问日期用 date，询问星期几用 day。 What's the date today?

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 回答某月几号，日常口语可以把序数放在月份后面。 It's June the third.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 要约在这一天见面，具体日期前面应选 on。 Let's meet on the third of June.
items: Let's meet on the third of June.

question: 问具体是几月几日，应说什么？
choices: What day of the week is it?
explanation: date 指日期。

title: 帮朋友找票

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 演出马上开场，朋友在找自己的票。用 where's 问位置。 Where's my ticket?

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 依次检查地点，in my pocket 是在我的口袋里。否定回答说明搜索要继续。 It isn't in my pocket.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 发现票掉在椅子后面，用 behind 告诉朋友，不要和 under 混淆。 It's behind the chair.

question: 票在椅子后面，位置词该用什么？
explanation: behind 指在后方。

title: 描述走廊里正在发生的事

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 听见走廊有人说话，想问发生了什么，可以用这个常见问句。 What's going on?

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 朝窗外看，两个同学正在搬箱子。描述眼前的动作，are 后接 carrying。 Two pupils are carrying a box.
items: Two pupils are carrying a box.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 若看到一人正在画海报，把主语和 be 一起换。 A girl is painting a poster.
items: Two pupils are carrying a box.
A girl is painting a poster.

question: 现在有两个学生正在搬东西，应选什么形式？
explanation: 复数主语搭配 are，进行时还需 carrying。

title: 排练室的音量控制

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 听学校乐队排练，drums 是鼓。说一项正在演奏的乐器。 The boy is playing the drums.
items: The boy is playing the drums.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 修饰演奏的方式，形容词 loud 可以变成副词 loudly。 He is playing loudly.
items: The boy is playing the drums.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 如果旁边有人阅读，礼貌地请乐手轻一点，用 more quietly。 Could you play more quietly, please?
items: Could you play more quietly, please?

question: He plays loudly 中哪个词描述动作的方式？
explanation: 副词 loudly 说明奏得很响。

title: 选材料要说出手感

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 制作布偶前要挑材料。拉绒布摸起来软，用 feels 加形容词。 The cloth feels soft.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 砂纸摸起来粗糙。把两个材料放在一句里，用 but 对比。 The cloth is soft, but the sandpaper is rough.
items: The cloth is soft, but the sandpaper is rough.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 请同桌闭眼试摸，把自己的结论变成问句。 How does this cloth feel?
items: The cloth is soft, but the sandpaper is rough.

question: 哪一个回答在说触感？
explanation: rough 形容粗糙的手感。

title: 不用重复名词也能比较

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 两人比较书包。先说我的书包是红的，再问对方的。yours 代指 your bag。 My bag is red. What about yours?
items: My bag is red. What about yours?

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 回答时，可以用 mine 单独作主语，不要在它后面再写 bag。 Mine is green.
items: My bag is red. What about yours?

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 若书包属于我们两个人，要用 ours。用一句话介绍归属。 The green bag is ours.

question: Your notebook is blue. ___ is yellow. 表示“我的”应填什么？
explanation: mine 单独代替 my notebook。

title: 电话里比较两地天气

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 通过电话问另一座城市天气，问句里有 like，意思是怎么样。 What's the weather like in Shanghai?
items: What's the weather like in Shanghai?

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 在阳光明媚和刮风之间用 and 连接，两个现象可以同时出现。 It's sunny and windy here.
items: What's the weather like in Shanghai?

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 把听来的天气作比较，说出你所在地方的不同情况。 It's rainy here, but it's sunny there.
items: It's rainy here, but it's sunny there.

question: What's the weather like? 问的是哪方面？
explanation: 这里的 like 与 what 连起来询问怎么样。

unit: Unit 9 · What are you going to do?
title: 询问周末的打算

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 要问朋友周末已经有什么打算，使用 be going to 加动词原形。 What are you going to do this weekend?
items: What are you going to do this weekend?

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 回答时，I 用 am，visit 仍是原形。 I am going to visit my aunt.
items: What are you going to do this weekend?
I am going to visit my aunt.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 换成两人一起做事，要用 we are。说说你们想去公园做什么。 We are going to fly a kite.
items: I am going to visit my aunt.
We are going to fly a kite.

question: He ___ going to make a kite. 空格用哪个词？
explanation: 第三人称单数 he 与 is 搭配。

unit: Unit 10 · It is going to rain tomorrow
title: 根据迹象作天气预测

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 天空布满厚厚的乌云。先说你亲眼看到的情况，用 there are。 There are dark clouds in the sky.
items: There are dark clouds in the sky.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 再说根据迹象的预测。这里 going to 后面用动词 rain。 It is going to rain.
items: There are dark clouds in the sky.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 为了上学出门，给同伴一个可执行的建议，带上雨伞。 Take an umbrella with you.

question: 哪句话是对将来的预测？
explanation: be going to 指接下来可能发生的事。

title: 让动物自己介绍尾巴

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 给小松鼠配第一人称旁白，要用 my 表示我的。 My tail is long and fluffy.
items: My tail is long and fluffy.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 描述作用，用 helps me 加动作。balance 表示保持平衡。 My tail helps me balance.
items: My tail is long and fluffy.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 如果换成旁观者介绍这只松鼠，my 变 its，me 换成 it。 Its tail helps it balance.

question: 从小松鼠自己的口吻介绍尾巴，应怎么开头？
explanation: 第一人称说自己的东西，用 my。

title: 写家庭作业的检查便条

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 朋友交作业前总会漏题。先列出已完成的任务，homework 通常不用加 s。 I finish my homework before dinner.
items: I finish my homework before dinner.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 再检查每页的姓名和题号。each 后面用单数 page。 I check each page.
items: I finish my homework before dinner.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 试着把提醒写成给自己的指令，直接从动词 check 开始。 Check your name and the date.
items: Check your name and the date.

question: each 后该接哪种形式？
explanation: each 后面直接接单数可数名词。

unit: Unit 1 · What do you want to be in the future?
title: 采访十年后的自己

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 想象十年后的自己，不用现在就决定职业。问对方将来想成为什么人。 What do you want to be in the future?
items: What do you want to be in the future?

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 说想成为一名工程师，要用 an engineer，前面是元音音素。 I want to be an engineer.
items: What do you want to be in the future?
I want to be an engineer.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 把理由补具体，说自己喜欢设计什么。because 可以将两句想法连起来。 I want to design bridges because I like solving problems.
items: I want to be an engineer.
I want to design bridges because I like solving problems.

question: 哪句表达对未来职业的愿望？
choices: I want to be an engineer.
explanation: want to be 表示想成为。

unit: Unit 2 · What does Sandy like to learn?
title: 说出自己想学的乐器

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 课外班报名时，想问一位同学喜欢学什么。主语是 Sandy，疑问句用 does。 What does Sandy like to learn?
items: What does Sandy like to learn?

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 把问句改成陈述句，Sandy 后的 like 要加 s。学习演奏乐器，可以用 learn to play。 Sandy likes to learn new songs.
items: What does Sandy like to learn?
Sandy likes to learn new songs.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 说更具体的学习目标时，加上乐器的名称。 Sandy wants to learn to play the violin.
items: Sandy likes to learn new songs.
Sandy wants to learn to play the violin.

question: Does Sandy ___ music? 正确形式是什么？
explanation: does 后面的动词回到原形。

title: 写好生日邀请与回复

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 组织生日会，邀请函先写谁在什么时候办活动。invite 表示邀请。 I'd like to invite you to my party on Saturday.
items: I'd like to invite you to my party on Saturday.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 别忘了约见地点和时刻。at six 说明时间，at my home 说明地点。 It starts at six at my home.
items: I'd like to invite you to my party on Saturday.
It starts at six at my home.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 收到邀请，如果当天有事，先感谢，再礼貌说明情况。 Thank you for inviting me, but I can't come on Saturday.
items: It starts at six at my home.
Thank you for inviting me, but I can't come on Saturday.

question: 哪条信息最能帮助客人准时到？
explanation: starts at six 提供了开始时间。

title: 把天气观察和解释分开

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 操场上的风向旗动起来了。先报告你观察到的事。 The flag is moving in the wind.
items: The flag is moving in the wind.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 想解释阳光给地面带来的变化，warm 作动词可以表示使变暖。 Sunlight warms the ground.
items: The flag is moving in the wind.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 再看阴影里的地面，比一比温度。比较两处用 cooler than。 This patch in the shade is cooler than the sunny patch.
items: This patch in the shade is cooler than the sunny patch.

question: 哪句是用眼睛就能直接观察的？
explanation: 旗子是否在动可以当下观察到。

title: 用同一标准比较学校

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 给外地伙伴介绍两所上海学校。先选择同一方面比较，比如都有阅读空间。 Both schools have a library.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 再说不同，一所图书馆在一楼，另一所在二楼。the other 指两者中的另一所。 One library is downstairs. The other is upstairs.
items: One library is downstairs. The other is upstairs.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 说清这些信息从哪里来。比如你刚刚参观过两所学校。 I visited both schools with my class.
items: One library is downstairs. The other is upstairs.
I visited both schools with my class.

question: only two schools 的另一所用什么表达清楚？
explanation: 两者之一说 one，另一所说 the other。

title: 周末计划临时改变

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 原计划周末去骑车，先用 was going to 交代过去的打算。 I was going to ride my bike on Saturday.
items: I was going to ride my bike on Saturday.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 突然下雨，只好换活动。instead 表示取而代之，可以放句尾。 It rained, so I read a book instead.
items: I was going to ride my bike on Saturday.
It rained, so I read a book instead.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 现在约下一个周末，先问同伴有没有空。 Are you free next weekend?
items: It rained, so I read a book instead.

question: I read a book instead 中的 instead 意味着什么？
explanation: instead 说明改做另一件事。

title: 设计半日上海游

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 只有半天，给朋友推荐一条可说清顺序的线路。先确定第一站。 First, walk along the Bund.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 用 then 转到下一站，并说交通方式。by bus 和 on foot 的搭配不同。 Then go to the museum by bus.
items: Then go to the museum by bus.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 最后提醒集合点，避免只给景点名却找不到同伴。 Meet at the museum entrance at noon.
items: Then go to the museum by bus.
Meet at the museum entrance at noon.

question: 哪条说明讲清了第二站的交通方式？
choices: Then take a bus to the museum.
explanation: take a bus 明确了搭乘公交。

title: 给班级墙报写标题

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 墙报标题要短，还要告诉读者发生了什么。先决定事件是班级图书交换。 Our Class Opens a Book Swap.
items: Our Class Opens a Book Swap.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 报道首句补上谁、何时和哪里。不要把采访意见说成全班的想法。 Class Five held a book swap in the hall on Friday.
items: Our Class Opens a Book Swap.
Class Five held a book swap in the hall on Friday.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 引述投票结果时给人数，能让读者了解想法来自多少人。 Eight pupils said they wanted another book swap.
items: Class Five held a book swap in the hall on Friday.
Eight pupils said they wanted another book swap.

question: 哪句给出了可核对的参与信息？
choices: Ten pupils brought books on Friday.
explanation: 十名和星期五都是可核对的事实。

title: 在上海餐馆分工点餐

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 和伙伴一起点餐，先询问是否能看菜单。menu 指菜单。 Could we see the menu, please?
items: Could we see the menu, please?

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 问一份有多少只，用 how many，dumplings 是复数。 How many dumplings are in one portion?
items: Could we see the menu, please?
How many dumplings are in one portion?

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 知道一份的量以后再决定点几份。把数量说在 portions 前面。 We'll have two portions, please.
items: How many dumplings are in one portion?

question: 你想知道一份里面有几只小笼包，应怎么问？
choices: How many dumplings are in one portion?
explanation: how many 问可数物品的数量。

title: 用依据支持未来预测

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 想象将来的校园。没有把握时可用 might 来提出一种可能。 Our school might have a roof garden.
items: Our school might have a roof garden.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 别只说会发生什么，还要说明为什么这样想。because 引出屋顶空地这条理由。 We could grow vegetables there because the roof has space.
items: Our school might have a roof garden.
We could grow vegetables there because the roof has space.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 把预测和已经发生的事实分开。介绍现在条件时用现在时。 There is open space on the roof now.
items: We could grow vegetables there because the roof has space.
There is open space on the roof now.

question: 哪句话清楚表示一种可能性？
choices: The school might add a garden.
explanation: might 表示有可能，不能把预测当成已经发生的事。

title: 闰日的日历说明

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 二月的日历有的到二十八号，有的还有二十九号。给伙伴介绍额外的一天。 A leap day is an extra day in February.
items: A leap day is an extra day in February.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 说具体某一天，用 on；说单独一个月份，用 in。对比下面两种时间表达。 The extra day falls on the twenty-ninth of February.
items: A leap day is an extra day in February.
The extra day falls on the twenty-ninth of February.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 再举一个只说明月份的例子，帮助朋友辨别 in 和 on。 My birthday is in February.
items: The extra day falls on the twenty-ninth of February.

question: 说“在二月二十九日”的开头应选什么？
explanation: 具体到哪一日在英语里通常用 on。

title: 循着线索找噪音

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 读原创短故事。小安正在做作业，却听到楼上传来一阵敲击声。先找地点词。 An hears a noise upstairs.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 她去看看，发现有人在修椅子。因为这一条线索，她知道响声怎么来的。 Her neighbour is fixing a chair.
items: Her neighbour is fixing a chair.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 把发现讲完整，because 后面说噪音的原因。 It is noisy because someone is fixing a chair.
items: Her neighbour is fixing a chair.
It is noisy because someone is fixing a chair.

question: 故事里为什么听到敲击声？
choices: A neighbour is fixing a chair.
explanation: fixing a chair 说明声音来自修椅子。

title: 读两则简短天气报告

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 天气阅读要看关键词旁边的时间。清晨有雾用 foggy。 It is foggy in the morning.
items: It is foggy in the morning.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 中午前后天气会转晴，clear 形容天空晴朗；by noon 指到中午时。 The sky will be clear by noon.
items: It is foggy in the morning.
The sky will be clear by noon.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 如果中午后去散步，不能只根据清晨那句话。把两个时段合并复述。 It starts foggy, but it gets clear later.
items: The sky will be clear by noon.
It starts foggy, but it gets clear later.

question: by noon 在预报里说明什么？
explanation: noon 是中午。

unit: Reading 4 · The lion and the mouse
title: 谁怎样帮助了谁

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 读一个狮子和老鼠的寓言线索。狮子被困在网里，net 是网。 The lion is caught in a net.
items: The lion is caught in a net.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 老鼠可以用小牙咬绳子。判断是谁行动，要看动作前面的主语。 The mouse bites the rope.
items: The lion is caught in a net.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 结果狮子自由了。把原因和结果按顺序复述，试着给故事提炼一个道理。 The little mouse helps the lion get free.
items: The little mouse helps the lion get free.

question: 哪项是狮子脱困的直接原因？
choices: The lion has a loud voice.
explanation: 咬开绳子让网松开，才使狮子脱困。

title: 给叶贴画配制作说明

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 做一幅落叶贴画，先观察形状并选好几片已经落下的叶子。 Choose three fallen leaves.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 放在纸上试试构图，arrange 表示排列，还没有粘上去。 Arrange the leaves on the paper.
items: Arrange the leaves on the paper.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 最后确认位置后再贴，stick 作动词表示粘贴。大声读出顺序，伙伴才能照做。 Stick the leaves in place.
items: Arrange the leaves on the paper.

question: 哪一步通常应在粘贴之前做？
explanation: 排列好后再粘贴，还能调整位置。

title: 口述堆雪人的先后

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 用图卡模拟堆雪人。roll 表示滚，把雪滚成大球。 Roll a large snowball first.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 第二个雪球小一些，放在大球上。on top 表示在上方。 Put a smaller snowball on top.
items: Put a smaller snowball on top.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 最后给它添眼睛和鼻子，用 finish by 加动作说明收尾。 Finish by adding two eyes and a nose.
items: Put a smaller snowball on top.
Finish by adding two eyes and a nose.

question: 哪条指令表示把小球放在上面？
choices: Put a smaller snowball on top.
explanation: on top 描述放置的位置。

title: 凭动作理解人物兴趣

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 看到一段人物介绍，不要根据名字猜兴趣。先看人物做了什么。 Alex practises ballet after school.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 原文还说 Alex 每周都练，说明对舞蹈投入时间，但没有说明别的孩子都喜欢什么。 Alex practises twice a week.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 选一条有证据支撑的结论，用 because 说明根据。 Alex is interested in dance because Alex practises often.
items: Alex is interested in dance because Alex practises often.

question: 哪条结论有文字依据？
explanation: 每周练习两次支持 regularly，文中没有对其他人下结论。

title: 从小事推断人物性格

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 一位同学看到老人提着重袋子。直接证据是文字写下的动作。 The boy offers to carry a heavy bag.
items: The boy offers to carry a heavy bag.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: helpful 是对人物性格的推断，需要把动作作为依据。 He is helpful because he offers to carry the bag.
items: The boy offers to carry a heavy bag.
He is helpful because he offers to carry the bag.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 再用一个不同的例子说明体贴，看看句中哪个词是行动。 He holds the door for the woman.
items: He is helpful because he offers to carry the bag.
He holds the door for the woman.

question: 哪部分是判断 helpful 的证据？
choices: He offers to carry the bag.
explanation: 主动帮忙提重袋直接支持乐于助人的判断。

title: 核对购物找零

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 在小店买文具，change 在收银台指零钱。带着应付、实付、找回三个数去读。 The notebook costs eight yuan.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 付十元，应该找回两元。若收到三元，就多了一元。 I paid ten yuan and got three yuan back.
items: I paid ten yuan and got three yuan back.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 想把多找的一元还回去，可以礼貌地指出发生了什么。 I think you gave me one yuan too much.
items: I paid ten yuan and got three yuan back.
I think you gave me one yuan too much.

question: 付十元买八元的本子，正确找零多少？
explanation: 十减八等于二。

title: 读懂木偶制作说明

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 制作一个纸木偶，先分清部件和用途。string 是细绳，用来控制动作。 Tie a string to the puppet's arm.
items: Tie a string to the puppet's arm.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 拉动绳子，再观察什么跟着动。when 表示这两个动作的时间联系。 The arm moves when you pull the string.
items: Tie a string to the puppet's arm.
The arm moves when you pull the string.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 如果想让另一只手也动，需要把绳子系在相应部位。试讲给同伴听。 Tie another string to the other arm.
items: The arm moves when you pull the string.
Tie another string to the other arm.

question: 哪一个动作会带动木偶的手？
choices: Pull the string attached to its arm.
explanation: 系在手上的绳子可以传递拉力带动手臂。

title: 用字母顺序查词典

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 查英语词典，先比较第一个字母。bag、bed、bus 都以 b 开头，需要再比第二个字母。 Look at the second letter.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: a 在 e 前，e 在 u 前，所以这三个词的顺序是 bag、bed、bus。 Bag comes before bed, and bed comes before bus.
items: Bag comes before bed, and bed comes before bus.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 找到单词后还要看例句，选符合上下文的义项。比如 bank 在 river bank 中是河岸。 The boat is near the river bank.
items: Bag comes before bed, and bed comes before bus.
The boat is near the river bank.

question: bag、bed、bus 已经同为 b 开头，接下来比较什么？
explanation: 按字母顺序逐位比较。

title: 设计让别人猜得出的字谜

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 设计英语字谜先选答案。如选 clock，不能在提示里直接出现这个词。 It has a face, but it cannot see.
items: It has a face, but it cannot see.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 第二条提示要能缩小范围。它有指针，还告诉我们时间。 Its hands show the time.
items: It has a face, but it cannot see.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 请同伴猜，若对方能说明两条线索怎样对应，就说明谜面有用。 The answer is a clock.

question: 哪条线索对猜 clock 最有帮助？
explanation: 指针表示时间是钟的辨识特征。

title: 三个线索猜一种水果

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 你来给同学出一张线索卡。先说水果表皮摸起来怎样，再说闻到的气味。 The skin feels smooth.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 如果想说味道，就用 tastes 加味道词。注意 sweet 和 smooth 不能随便对换。 It tastes sweet.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 最后只凭这些线索还不能确定答案，再加一个颜色缩小范围。 It is purple and small.

question: 哪项是味觉线索？
explanation: tastes 和 sweet 描述尝到的感觉。

title: 用三句话介绍喜欢的东西

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 按用途给句子配动词。说喜欢的动物用 like，喜欢这一类要用复数。 I like rabbits.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 说自己拥有的玩具用 have，穿着什么衣服常用 wear。 I have a toy rabbit.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 换成介绍你常穿的衣服，例如在凉爽的天气穿蓝色外套。 I wear a blue coat on cool days.
items: I wear a blue coat on cool days.

question: 想表达“我有一只玩具兔”，选哪句？
explanation: have 表示拥有。

title: 把公园拼贴画讲给伙伴

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 画一棵秋天的树，先说季节，再数画里用了几种形状。 It is autumn in my picture.
items: It is autumn in my picture.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 同伴猜哪一个是太阳，可以告诉他图形和颜色。 The sun is a yellow circle.
items: It is autumn in my picture.
The sun is a yellow circle.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 换同伴介绍树上的叶子，注意许多树叶要用 leaves。 The leaves are red and yellow.
items: The sun is a yellow circle.
The leaves are red and yellow.

question: 哪句话同时给出了形状和颜色？
explanation: green 是颜色，triangle 是图形。

title: 把动作编成节日小故事

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 将儿童节表演写成三句。先说上台的动作。 First, we walk onto the stage.
items: First, we walk onto the stage.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 中间安排一个身体动作，把 hands 的复数读清楚。 Then we clap our hands.
items: First, we walk onto the stage.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 最后告诉观众故事已经结束。用 finally 邀请伙伴一起谢幕。 Finally, we take a bow.

question: 听到 Then we clap our hands，演员该怎样做？
explanation: clap one's hands 是拍手。

title: 从听到的特征选玩具

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 听一条谜语。它不是活的，摸起来软，而且有两只长耳朵。 It is a toy with two long ears.
items: It is a toy with two long ears.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 先区分哪条线索来自触觉。soft 描述手感，long 描述外表。 It feels soft.
items: It is a toy with two long ears.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 汇总三条线索，再向出题人核实你的猜测。 Is it a toy rabbit?

question: 下列哪条线索需要用手感知？
explanation: 软硬靠触摸分辨。

title: 做一段完整的游园播报

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 在班级游园会上先说明季节，再说一个能看到的事物。 It is spring. I can see green leaves.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 第二句补上声音线索。hear 后面说听到谁或什么声音。 I can hear birds in the trees.
items: It is spring. I can see green leaves.
I can hear birds in the trees.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 最后提出一个集体活动建议。请同伴核对，你有没有说到季节、感觉和活动。 Let's play a game in the park.
items: I can hear birds in the trees.
Let's play a game in the park.

question: 播报里哪句是邀请而非观察？
explanation: Let's 引出一起做某事的提议。

title: 做一份多感官记录

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 把水果的外观、气味、触感写到不同栏里。外观动词 look 后加形容词。 The lemon looks yellow.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 果皮摸上去有点粗糙，用 feels，不要用 tastes。 Its skin feels rough.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 如果只是闻过，暂时不评价味道。写一条你能证实的气味观察。 It smells fresh.

question: 哪条记录可以放进触感栏？
explanation: feel 说明用触觉得到的感受。

title: 区分本领、爱好和此刻动作

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 同一项活动能用三种方式讲。can swim 表示会不会，是本领。 I can swim.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: like swimming 表示喜欢游泳，am swimming 表示此刻正在游泳。 I like swimming.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 在时间词 now 的提示下，选正在做的形式给泳池里的画面配音。 I am swimming now.

question: 哪句只说明游泳是我的爱好？
explanation: like 后的 swimming 说明爱好。

title: 读广播里的三个时间线索

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 一条广播可能同时给出星期、时刻和先后。先听清活动在哪一天。 Music club meets on Tuesday.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 再记下具体时刻。half past four 表示四点半，不是三点半。 We start at half past four.
items: We start at half past four.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 最后一个线索说活动在课后。试把三条合并成一句邀请。 Meet us after school on Tuesday at half past four.
items: We start at half past four.
Meet us after school on Tuesday at half past four.

question: 广播中的准确活动时刻是哪一个？
explanation: half past four 是四点三十分。

title: 给节日音乐剧做主持

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 节目要介绍一个节日、一件乐器和一个故事。先说故事发生在端午节。 Our story begins at the Dragon Boat Festival.
items: Our story begins at the Dragon Boat Festival.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 再介绍准备演奏乐器的演员。说奏鼓是 play the drum。 Bo plays the drum in our story.
items: Our story begins at the Dragon Boat Festival.
Bo plays the drum in our story.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 最后邀请观众听开场，直接从 listen 开始，把注意力引向声音。 Listen to the first beat.
items: Bo plays the drum in our story.

question: 哪句介绍了乐器分工？
explanation: 人物 Bo 与鼓 drum 都出现了。

title: 从描述中找到正确的物品

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 有一只软布球和一只硬木球。听同学说想接哪一只，先抓描述手感的词。 Please pass me the soft ball.
items: Please pass me the soft ball.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 再观察同学此刻的动作。用进行时说明他在练习传球。 He is practising with a friend.
items: Please pass me the soft ball.
He is practising with a friend.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 如果桌上换成粗糙的布球，改换一个形容词再发请求。 Please pass me the rough ball.
items: He is practising with a friend.
Please pass me the rough ball.

question: 面对软布球和硬木球，应把哪一个递给说 soft ball 的人？
explanation: soft 这个手感线索指向软布球。

title: 从周计划表讲到现场

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 比较周计划和今天的实际活动。惯常每周六练球，用 usually。 We usually play ball on Saturdays.
items: We usually play ball on Saturdays.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 今天雨很大，大家改在室内排演节日节目。描述当下用 are 加 ing。 Today we are practising a festival play instead.
items: We usually play ball on Saturdays.
Today we are practising a festival play instead.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 加上改变的原因，读者能理解两句并不矛盾。 We are staying inside because it is raining.
items: Today we are practising a festival play instead.
We are staying inside because it is raining.

question: 哪一个词最清楚标出惯常安排？
explanation: usually 意为通常。

title: 失物卡上的现在和过去

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 小花盆找不到主人。标签上的 mine 表示是说话者自己的。 The small pot is mine.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 用两句按时间记录花盆里的植物。过去一颗种子用 was，现在一株小苗用 is。 It was a seed, but now it is a plant.
items: It was a seed, but now it is a plant.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 请同伴指出表示过去、现在、归属的三个词，再报告变化。 My plant has two leaves now.
items: It was a seed, but now it is a plant.
My plant has two leaves now.

question: 要说这个花盆属于我，应写 The pot is ___.
explanation: mine 可以单独代替 my pot。

title: 组织班级电影午餐会

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 先听同学最喜欢的学科，按兴趣挑电影。科学组想看海洋纪录片。 We choose a film about the sea because we like science.
items: We choose a film about the sea because we like science.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 为观影准备点心。苹果可以数，果汁通常按量说。 We need four apples and some juice.
items: We choose a film about the sea because we like science.
We need four apples and some juice.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 结束活动时，请同伴用 because 给出电影推荐理由。 I recommend this film because it shows real sea animals.
items: We need four apples and some juice.
I recommend this film because it shows real sea animals.

question: 哪句正确区分可数和不可数？
choices: a apples and two juices of bowl
explanation: apples 可以数，some juice 表示一些果汁。

title: 给变化后的步道写提示

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 之前空地上有一条泥路，用 there was 描述过去。 There was a narrow path here.
items: There was a narrow path here.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 现在已经铺上新步道，又下过雨。想提醒路人注意脚下，标识要简单。 Wet path. Walk slowly.
items: There was a narrow path here.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 补一句解释路为什么湿，注意谈刚发生的雨用过去式。 The path is wet because it rained this morning.
items: The path is wet because it rained this morning.

question: 哪句适合作为此刻步道上的提示？
choices: Walk slowly on the wet path.
It may be sunny next year.
explanation: 祈使句直接告诉行人如何行动。

title: 把文化参观写成小故事

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 参观节日主题展。记叙文第一句交代地点和时间，过去的参观用 visited。 We visited a festival museum last week.
items: We visited a festival museum last week.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 选择一个有意思的展品，写清楚自己学到什么，而非泛泛说很好。 I learned how one family made festival lanterns.
items: We visited a festival museum last week.
I learned how one family made festival lanterns.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 结尾说离开前的一件事，finally 提示读者已到最后一步。 Finally, we drew our own lantern designs.
items: I learned how one family made festival lanterns.
Finally, we drew our own lantern designs.

question: 哪句表明参观发生在过去？
choices: We visited the museum last week.
explanation: visited 和 last week 都指向过去。

title: 为观察日记选对动词

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 读三条昨天的记录，找出不规则过去式。grow 过去变 grew。 The plant grew taller.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: hear 变 heard，like 比较规则，词尾加 d。留心三个词的拼写。 I heard a bird outside.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 轮到你用昨天喜欢的电影造句，记得已有时间线索时要用过去时。 I liked the film yesterday.

question: Yesterday, I ___ a loud bell. 应填什么？
explanation: 昨天听见，用 hear 的过去式 heard。

title: 一封让读者能行动的参观信

scenes.label: 听懂关键词
scenes.say: 给朋友写参观邀请。先说参观什么，然后给具体时间地点。 Meet us at the museum gate at ten on Sunday.
items: Meet us at the museum gate at ten on Sunday.

scenes.label: 跟读与发现
scenes.say: 参观前要读规则，写清有什么行为被禁止。 We mustn't touch the old clocks.
items: Meet us at the museum gate at ten on Sunday.
We mustn't touch the old clocks.

scenes.label: 换你来说
scenes.say: 最后让对方知道有疑问该问谁。自己读一遍，检查时间、地点、规则是否齐全。 Ask our group leader if you need help.
items: We mustn't touch the old clocks.
Ask our group leader if you need help.

question: 哪句话能帮助接到邀请的人准时找到同伴？
choices: Meet at the museum gate at ten.
explanation: gate 给出地点，at ten 给出时间。
